title: Atomic Functions Addendum — Add-Position Flow and Active-Position Lock (AF-38/AF-39)

atomic_functions.name: Add position via Watch List form
atomic_functions.purpose: Handle the Watch List add-position form submission — validate the form fields, run the active-position lock check (AF-39), insert exactly ONE bonds master row, and redirect to the watch list where the monthly grid, dashboard and watch list all render that same stored row (D14). A company/position is added once; no surface ever asks for the same details a second time.
inputs: POST add-position form (company, ISIN, amount, tenure, start month)
outputs: success flash naming the added company
redirect to the watch list (grid, dashboard and watch list render the same row)
triggers: User submits the Watch List add-position form
postconditions: Form fields validated before any write; invalid input produces a visible named error via AF-30, never a silent drop
Active-position lock check (AF-39) passed before any INSERT; a blocked add writes nothing
Exactly ONE bonds master row is inserted per successful submission — the monthly grid, dashboard and watch list all render from that same row (D14)
On success: flash message names the added company and the response redirects to the watch list
No duplicate row, no second entry surface, no per-view re-entry of the same company/position details
Every failure surfaces visibly via AF-30 naming the failed operation; a blocked or failed add never redirects as success (FR-21)

atomic_functions.name: Active position lock validator
atomic_functions.purpose: Enforce the D15 active-position lock at add time: block a new position when EITHER the normalized company name (trimmed, case-insensitive) OR the ISIN matches an existing active position (live D5 status On-going or Danger). The match is a HARD BLOCK with a named error that identifies the blocking position and its status; there is no override and no force-accept. The lock releases only when the existing position reaches Completed.
outputs: pass verdict when no active position matches by either key
named hard-block error naming the blocking position and its status when a match exists
triggers: Add-position form submission (AF-38) runs this validator before any INSERT
preconditions: Status engine available (AF-14) for Completed/active determination
postconditions: D15 applied exactly: "At most ONE active (On-going or Danger) position may exist per company. The duplicate match key is the normalized company name (trimmed, case-insensitive) OR the ISIN: a new add is blocked if EITHER key matches an active position. Enforcement is a HARD BLOCK with a named error that identifies the blocking position and its status (surfaced per FR-21); there is no override and no force-accept. The lock releases ONLY when the existing position reaches Completed (D5: months paid >= tenure). A new position bought after Completed starts On-going and re-locks the company until it too completes."
Active set = positions whose live D5 status is On-going or Danger; Completed positions are excluded (the status engine is never bypassed and no status column is stored or read)
Name matching normalizes by trim + lowercase so case and whitespace variants of the same company name match
Either key matching blocks — an ISIN match blocks even when the company names differ, and a name match blocks even when ISINs differ

On a match, the raised named error identifies the blocking position and its status (e.g. 'Cannot add position: Muthoottu has an active position (On-going)'); no override or force-accept branch exists anywhere in this function
When the existing position reaches Completed the same candidate passes; a new position bought after Completed starts On-going and re-locks the company for the next add
